board-move-state-not-on-board:
error: Issue acme/demo/7 is not on the project board
  hint: add it to the board first with board_add with issue_ref: "acme/demo/7"
board-show-state:
error: no active project
  run: project_activate with project: <PROJECT>
board-sync-state-ambiguous-project:
error: no active project, and 2 project configs exist
  run: board_sync with project: <NAME>
  available: ghes.example.com_acme_board_acme, ghes.example.com_acme_other_acme
issue-comment-usage-message-without-issu: error: issue_ref (Issue reference) is required with message
issue-create-usage-no-args:
error: missing arguments
  direct posting: issue_create with title: <TITLE>, repo: "owner/repo", message: <BODY>
  free format: issue_create with freeform: true, repo: "owner/repo", message: <BODY>
  prepare a template: issue_create with prepare: true, template: "task", repo: "owner/repo"
  from a file: issue_create with files: <path>
issue-create-usage-prepare-no-repo: error: repo: <owner/repo> is required with prepare: true unless template: "epic"
pr-create-state-screenshot: error: Summary has no image and `screenshot` gives no reason to omit one. If the change alters a screen, Markdown the tool writes for GitHub, or CLI output text, take a screenshot and add it to Summary as `![alt](./<file>.png)`. Otherwise, write the reason in the `screenshot` frontmatter field (`screenshot` with `message`)
pr-create-usage:
error: missing arguments
  usage:
  pr_create with prepare: true
  pr_create with file: <path>
  pr_create with message: <body>, title: <title>, base: <base-branch>
project-activate-4xx:
error: could not read the authenticated user: resource not found: {{GITHUB_API}}/user
  pass owner to give the owner explicitly
project-activate-state:
error: host is required
  example: project_activate with host: "github.com", owner: "example-org"
  example: project_activate with host: "ghes.example.com", owner: "example-org"
  example: project_activate with project: "ghes.example.com_example-org_example-project_example-org"
project-get-state:
error: no active project
  run: project_activate with project: <PROJECT>
project-link-state:
error: give the repository as owner/repo
  example: project_link with repo: "example-org/my-repo"
project-unset-state:
error: no active project
  run: project_activate with project: <PROJECT>
release-create-state-no-release-branch:
error: release_branch is not set for acme/demo
  set it with: project_link with repo: "acme/demo", release_branch: <branch>
session-restore-state-no-issue-number:
error: cannot infer the Issue number from the branch name: feat/no-number
  run: session_restore with issue_ref: <owner/repo/N>
session-start-state-repo-mismatch:
error: the repository of the work Issue (acme/other) differs from the CWD git remote (acme/demo)
  move to the worktree of the target repository and run again:
  <project-root>/base/other/ or <project-root>/<wtN>/other/
  create one with /pecot-w:w-worktree-add only if the repository has no worktree
  to issue the command on purpose from outside the CWD (for example in a script), give allow_cross_repo: true
worktree-add-state-no-config:
error: worktree config not found: .pecot/config/worktree-config.json
    run worktree_init to generate the template
worktree-add-state-not-registered:
error: repository acme/demo is not registered in the active pecot project
  
  registered repositories:
    - acme/other
  
  to add this repository to the pecot project:
    project_link with repo: "acme/demo"
  
  to switch to another project:
    project_activate with project: <PROJECT>
worktree-link-state-main-worktree: error: use all: true in the main worktree
worktree-link-state-no-config:
error: worktree config not found
  run: worktree_init with directory: <directory>
